findings.title: kernel-refresh marker keyed on a bare PID — a SIGKILLed merge leaks it and PID reuse silently disarms the refusal, while `_pid_start` (already used by `lock_acquire` for exactly this) is not consulted
the "costs zero subprocesses" claim on `orchid_root_stale`'s branch half is inaccurate — `config_get` runs for every root with a branch (tr/sed/grep/tail/cut), and check 11 only fences `git`

a staged (`git add`) kernel edit in the integration checkout hard-refuses every verb including `doctor` and `status`; deliberate and documented with an unstage remedy, but it is a real cost against the dirty-development criterion
